# Donelon Wild School of Dance (DW Dance)

> A children's dance school in Stretford, Greater Manchester, teaching ballet,
> tap and modern to ages 3–18. Founded in 2016 by Bethany Donelon and Sally
> Wild. Classes run from complete beginner to student grade, with NATD graded
> examinations. Classes run on Saturdays during term time, and private lessons
> are also available.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Donelon Wild School of Dance (short form: DW Dance)
- **Founded:** 2016, by Bethany Donelon and Sally Wild
- **Principal:** Miss Bethany Donelon
- **Location:** Stretford, Greater Manchester, England. The full venue address
  is given to families when they sign up.
- **Area served:** Stretford, Flixton, Urmston, Davyhulme and the rest of Trafford
- **Ages taught:** 3 to 18
- **Dance styles:** Ballet, Tap, Modern
- **Levels:** Complete beginner through to student grade
- **Examinations:** NATD (National Association of Teachers of Dancing) graded
  examinations. The school is NATD affiliated.
- **Class groups:** Beginners, Junior, Intermediate, Senior. Teachers advise
  which group and grade a child should attend.
- **When classes run:** All day on Saturdays during term time, starting with the
  youngest dancers in the morning and finishing with Seniors in the afternoon.
  Private lessons are available on request.
- **Term dates:** Published on the Classes & Pricing page.
- **Fees:** Contact the school for current prices.
- **Performances:** The school stages its own show every other year. Local
  festival work is offered to selected dancers who have reached the required grade.
- **Email:** miss.bethany@dwdance.co.uk (the main contact route)
- **Telephone:** 07910 603360 or 07778 323321
- **Dancewear store:** https://ddw.mydancestore.co.uk/ — there is no set
  uniform; families order what suits them.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.dwdance.co.uk/): overview of the school, dance styles,

- [Classes & Pricing](https://www.dwdance.co.uk/classes.html): class groups,
  dance styles, when classes run, term dates, fees and frequently asked questions.
- [Dancewear Store](https://www.dwdance.co.uk/store.html): link to the online

- [About Us](https://www.dwdance.co.uk/about.html): the school's story, teaching
  approach, performances, safeguarding and the teaching team.
- [Contact](https://www.dwdance.co.uk/contact.html): enquiry form, email address,

## Common questions this site answers

- What age can a child start dancing? Beginners classes take children from
  age 3. Senior classes run to 18.
- Does a child need previous experience? No. Every class group accepts complete
  beginners, and children are placed by stage rather than school year.
- What should a child wear to a first class? Comfortable clothes and bare feet
  or socks. There is no need to buy anything beforehand.
- When do classes run? Saturdays during term time. Private lessons are also
  available.
- How much do classes cost? Contact the school for current fees.
- Where are classes held? Stretford, in Trafford, Greater Manchester. The full
  address is given when a family signs up.
